lines.speaker: Cutter
lines.text: So, Freeza sent you to follow us, huh? Looks he wasn’t satisfied with just our planet!

lines.speaker: Cutter
lines.text: There’s no way we can let you people live! Not after what you did to our planet, our families!

lines.speaker: Cutter
lines.text: And now, for you crimes against our people…

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: OK, seriously, we have no idea what--

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Gohan, this may be it. Close your eyes!

lines.speaker: Cutter
lines.text: Oh my God... Freeza’s men are stronger than we thought!
Space orphans gasp in shock and horror

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: But we told you, we don’t know any Freeza--!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Krillin, can I open my eyes now?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: ...Just get back to the ship, Gohan.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: JUST GET BACK TO THE SHIP!
♫ Egao urutora zetto de ♫ (With a smile that’s Ultra-Z)
♫ Kyô mo ai-yai-yai-yai-yai~ ♫ (Even today is ai-yai-yai-yai-yai~)

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: "We’ve been flying for two weeks now. Starting to feel verrrry pent up..."

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: "Not just from being trapped on the ship of course, but from Bulma walking around in nothing but her UNDERWEAR!"

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: "I would relieve this tension, but I have had no alone time as the toilet KEEPS" SCREAMING AT ME!!

lines.speaker: Toilet
lines.text: Scheißen Sie auf meinem Gesicht! (German for "Shit in my face")

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: "I’m not sure how much longer I can last."

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Huh? You guys! You wouldn’t believe it, but... I see Planet Namek!

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Wait, how the hell do you know it’s Planet Name--

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Well, what do you know? Bring us in for a landing, Bulma.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Did I mention I don’t really know how to land this thing?

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: See? This is why women shouldn’t drive!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Oh, right. This coming from the Asian!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Well, I’m half-Saiyan. What does that make me?

lines.speaker: Zaacro
lines.text: Uh, are you sure they’re OK? They’ve been out for a long time.

lines.speaker: Raiti
lines.text: Of course I’m sure zey’re OK! Now just follow ze plan!

lines.speaker: Raiti
lines.text: Of course ve have ze plan, stupid! To take their ship, and get off zis stoopid rock.

lines.speaker: Raiti
lines.text: Oh crap, zey’re vaking up! Act natural, act natural!

lines.speaker: Zaacro
lines.text: So, uh, what brings you to, like, our planet?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Well, we’re here to search for the Dragon Balls.

lines.speaker: Raiti
lines.text: Eww! That’s disgusting! Vhy vould you--

lines.speaker: Zaacro
lines.text: I think they mean the ones that grant wishes.

lines.speaker: Raiti
lines.text: Oh yah, ve totally have zose! The vish-granting balls…

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Oh, well, if you wouldn’t mind helping us look for them...

lines.speaker: Raiti
lines.text: Oh yah, ve’ll help you find ze ball dragons.

lines.speaker: Raiti
lines.text: Ve should totally help zem find zem, and zen ve’ll take zem and zen ve’ll make our vish for ourselves!

lines.speaker: Zaacro
lines.text: Uhh, ours don’t actually grant any wishes. I think we made that up. Did we make that up?

lines.speaker: Raiti
lines.text: Vhat? Noooo. Vhy vould ve make zat up?

lines.speaker: Zaacro
lines.text: Well, ‘cause, like ya told me when we read their minds; that we wanted their ship so we could get off this planet.

lines.speaker: Raiti
lines.text: Zat’s… zat’s… nooo… zat’s, just no. Ve vould never do that, dude. Come on, not cool.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Krillin... do these two seem off to you?

lines.speaker: Raiti
lines.text: Time to find ze Dragon Balls!

lines.speaker: Dr. Birdenheim
lines.text: ...Yeah. He landed here a few days ago.

lines.speaker: Dr. Birdenheim
lines.text: He was pretty messed up, I’ll tell ya what.

lines.speaker: Rudy
lines.text: But, what happened to his partner?

lines.speaker: Dr. Birdenheim
lines.text: Well, that’s the screwed-up part. They say he killed his partner and that his ghost still haunts him to this very day.

lines.speaker: Dr. Birdenheim
lines.text: No! What are you; stupid? We’re doctors! Scientists!

lines.speaker: Dr. Birdenheim
lines.text: Now inject this man with some *science*!

lines.speaker: Dr. Birdenheim
lines.text: My God! We have to get him out of there!

lines.speaker: Rudy
lines.text: Uhh.. don’t you mean his heart rate…

lines.speaker: Dr. Birdenheim
lines.text: Damn it, man! I’m a *doctor*, not an English teacher!

lines.speaker: Dr. Birdenheim
lines.text: Good to see you’re awake, Vegeta.

lines.speaker: Dr. Birdenheim
lines.text: We have to apologize, though... we… couldn’t save your tail.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: It’s all right. I can live without it.

lines.speaker: Dr. Birdenheim
lines.text: If you call that living, you’d walk around a shell of your former self, everyone calling you a “tail-less freak!”

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: You know I could probably kill all of you and Freeza wouldn’t care.

lines.speaker: Dr. Birdenheim
lines.text: Yeah, but that still wouldn’t get your tail back.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Tell me something: Which is your favorite internal organ?

lines.speaker: Dr. Birdenheim
lines.text: What an odd question! But if I had to choose, I guess I would have to say my liver.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: 'You know, it’s the simple things in life...'

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Speaking of simple; what is it, Cui?

lines.speaker: Cui
lines.text: Where are you off to in such a hurry?

lines.speaker: Cui
lines.text: Hah! Shows what you know, Vegeta.

lines.speaker: Cui
lines.text: We heard about the Dragon Balls.

lines.speaker: Cui
lines.text: We know the Namekians made them, and Freeza is way ahead of you.

lines.speaker: Cui
lines.text: The Scouter was on the entire time.

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: That’s impossible! My transmitter was off the entire time! Whose scouter was--?!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Wow, you guys. We’ve already found two Dragon Balls.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Wow! This usually takes us, like, *months*!

lines.speaker: Raiti
lines.text: Zat’s because you’re on ze Planet Namek.

lines.speaker: Raiti
lines.text: You should totally stay here, forever.

lines.speaker: Raiti
lines.text: Oh, look it’s anozer Dragon Ball in ze lake. YOU SHOULD GO GET IT!

lines.speaker: Raiti
lines.text: Oh come on, dude. Vhat are you, chicken?

lines.speaker: Raiti
lines.text: Don’t you vant to have ze awesome adventures?

lines.speaker: Raiti
lines.text: On ze Planet Namek? Vith ze Dragon Balls?
♫ "Gotta Find That Dragon Ball!" - theme of Dragon Ball (BLT dub) ♫
♫ Don’t stop until you got 'em all ♫
♫ It’s all you gotta do to have your wish come true! ♫
♫ Everybody's searchin’ for the Dragon Ball! ♫

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Hey, um, I’ve been meaning to ask you guys... where are all the other Namekians?

lines.speaker: Raiti
lines.text: Oh, zey’re around. Don’t even pretend you didn’t see them.

lines.speaker: Zaacro
lines.text: Yeah, we passed ‘em like, three times.

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Come on, you guys! We only have one more Dragon Ball left! Then we can wish back our friends!

lines.speaker: Raiti
lines.text: Vhat?! NO! VE CAN’T LET YOU DO ZAT!

lines.speaker: Raiti
lines.text: See, ve can’t let you have ze Dragon Balls.

lines.speaker: Raiti
lines.text: Zey’re our Dragon Balls! Ve vill take zem and ve vill make our vish for ourselves!

lines.speaker: Raiti
lines.text: And zen you suck our three foot long Schwanzstuckers!

lines.speaker: Raiti
lines.text: Vhat?! Vhat are you talking about?! Of course ve do!

lines.speaker: Zaacro
lines.text: Uhh, actually, I, uh, read their minds... and I don’t think we do.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: You guys aren’t Namekians at all!

lines.speaker: Raiti
lines.text: Oh look vhat you’ve done, Zaacro!

lines.speaker: Raiti
lines.text: Vhy do you have to go and mess this up, blow our cover?

lines.speaker: Zaacro
lines.text: OK, I did not do that. Did I do that?

lines.speaker: Raiti
lines.text: Vell you must have ‘cause I would never do anything that stupid.

lines.speaker: Zaacro
lines.text: Well, there was that one time… when you got mad at those two guys… who just wanted to play a children’s card game.

lines.speaker: Zaacro
lines.text: And you made us chase after them… then we ended up crashing here… on this planet...

lines.speaker: Raiti
lines.text: Vhy did you have to bring zat up? Open those vounds…

lines.speaker: Raiti
lines.text: You know vhat? Screw it. Just summon ze tentacle monsters.

lines.speaker: Zaacro
lines.text: Oh, all right. Umm, tentacle monsters… heeeere. OK, I think that did it.

lines.speaker: Raiti
lines.text: Hah! Now soon, you vill deal vith ze many protruding tentacles of ze violating tentacle monster.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: Don’t worry, Bulma! I’ll protect you!

lines.speaker: Raiti
lines.text: I vas talking to you, Baldy.

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: No not there! Whoa, God! Help me! Help! Aaaaugh--

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: 'Oh God… oooh… oh man. That was… that was terrifying.'

lines.speaker: Kaiserneko
lines.text: I have got to stop editing so late.

lines.speaker: Nail
lines.text: I have terrible news: Someone has attacked the planet.

lines.speaker: Guru
lines.text: I must put on my war face.

segments.title: Space Orphans Cyanide
segments.quote: Oh my God... Freeza's men are stronger than we thought! Everyone! Take your cyanide tablets!

segments.title: Krillin's Log
segments.quote: "Krillin’s log, stardate: Uh, November 28th." ... SCREAMING AT ME!!

segments.quote: Well, I’m half-Saiyan. What does that make me? / *Five*!

segments.title: Totally Namekers
segments.quote: Ve’re totally Namekers. / You mean "Namekians"? / Yah, zose guys. Zat’s us!

segments.title: The Not-So-Secret Plan
segments.quote: Ve should totally help zem find zem... and zen ve’ll make our vish for ourselves! / Do these two seem off to you? / I like 'em!

segments.title: Ghost Nappa Haunts
segments.quote: 'God. Damn it. Nappa...!' / You were saying... saying… saying…?

segments.title: Doctor, Not an English Teacher
segments.quote: Damn it, man! I’m a *doctor*, not an English teacher!

segments.quote: The Scouter was on the entire time. / GOD DAMN IT, *NAPPAAAAAAAAA*...!!!

segments.quote: And ze awesome musical montage?! / ♫ Gotta find that Dragon Ball! ♫

segments.quote: Namekians don’t have penises! / Vhat?! Vhat are you talking about?! Of course ve do!

segments.quote: I must put on my war face. / There. Now show me yours. / Needs work.
